thread:
julia: quick sync on model onboarding for fenrir-6b + eucalyptus-13b. hit two blockers: licensing note on eucalyptus (possible non-commercial clause) and we still need perf profiles for the 99ms latency SLO. can owners confirm timelines? cc @tess_legal @kevin_infra @omar

omar: running lightweight perf now on staging, will paste numbers in a sec. can you confirm the sample prompt set (50) we should use?

tess_legal: saw the artifact — eucalyptus's LICENSE.md references 'research use only' in one place. need full provenance and confirmation of commercial rights before catalog publish. legal ETA ~3 business days once we have the repo link + license file. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

omar: quick results from today (staging, 1xA100, batch=1):
```
model: eucalyptus-13b
p50 token gen: 35ms
p95: 118ms
mem peak: 22GB
seq len: 512
throughput (1xGPU steady-state): ~11 tok/s
notes: attention kernels stable, kv cache warm-up +3ms
```

kevin_infra: infra notes — we have a dedicated canary slot Weds next week (UTC). requirements: quantized checkpoint + 50 prompt set + docker bundle. if ML provides the quantized artifact we can run the perf harness and smoke tests. otherwise we can run fp16 but throughput will differ.

liam_prod: catalog gating: if legal signoff + canary perf by Thu EOD we can keep the planned catalog publish. if either misses -> shift publish by 1 week. also propose fallback tile: fenrir-6b-quant as a temp default for demos.

julia: proposed plan -> 1) @omar produce quantized checkpoint + upload link by Tue EOD 2) @tess_legal confirm license by Fri (3 business days) 3) @kevin_infra run canary Wed -> post perf report 4) @liam_prod hold catalog freeze Thurs EOD. everyone ok? :white_check_mark:

omar: I can do quantize+upload by Tue EOD. I'll also attach the 50-prompt set here (using the short privacy-safe prompts).

kevin_infra: noted — please put the artifact in s3://redwood-model-artifacts/eucalyptus/quant-v1 and tag with commit sha. I'll kick the harness once it's present.

release-bot: scheduled: canary job eucalyptus-13b-quant-v1 -> node group canary-wed-2 @ 1719273600. logs will post to /canaries/eucalyptus/1719273600.

tess_legal: once we have the s3 link I'll do an initial license check (fast pass) and flag any problematic clauses. if we need legal review beyond quick pass I'll ping for a 1:1 with the originating author.

liam_prod: thanks. small ask: @omar can you include two short eval prompts that exercise instruction-following + safety filter edge-case? that will help quality gating in the catalog UI.

omar: yep adding those now. I'll report back with perf numbers after the canary run.

julia: excellent — I'll update the launch tracker and assign the items. I'll ping again Tue morning for status. thanks all. :rocket:
